snippet.title: Havenhold Game Overview Trailer - Join the Playtest
snippet.description:
Havenhold is a Combat-focused Social Sandbox inspired by the ancient Far East. Train as a warrior monk, wield primordial powers, craft, trade, and compete against rivals in riveting battles for access to the sacred peak.

Sign up for our upcoming Playtest now: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2015760?utm_campaign=Youtube
https://playhavenhold.com/

Join our Discord for the latest announcements and updates:
https://discord.com/invite/havenhold
